segments.summary: Walt and Madge walk their dog Wolf down a trail; a Klondike stranger, Skiff Miller, arrives and claims Wolf as his dog Brown. They agree to let the dog choose, and Wolf ultimately follows Miller.

cohesion.place: Mountain trail near the Irvines' cottage, Glen Ellen

segments.reason: The entire story is embedded in a single paragraph marker and unfolds in one continuous time/place (the trail on a spring morning). Although it contains a strong conflict over the dog's ownership, the whole passage—including extensive backstory and description—is presented as one cohesive block with no time/place breaks, so it is treated as a single coarse narrative scene.
